verdict.rationale: Fellow's site claims admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, while teams keep control over what they share. The API and MCP docs imply per-user access scoping, and the Super Admin API gives workspace-wide data retrieval. However, there is no concrete documentation of sharing controls themselves. Missing for 10: private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions, admin visibility or reporting into what has been shared, and independent corroboration.
